patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Asana documents a broader use-case set; VektorOS is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Asana only if your buying job matches “Cross-functional work management with goals, workflows and AI Studio — Starter from $10.99” rather than VektorOS's shape. Choose VektorOS only if your buying job matches “Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management.” rather than Asana's shape. Workflow advantage: Asana leans project-tracking, team-collaboration-work; VektorOS leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Asana documents a broader use-case set; VektorOS is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Asana is Cross-functional work management with goals, workflows and AI Studio — Starter from $10.99/user/mo annual.; VektorOS is Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management..
- Company-size focus: Asana (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs VektorOS (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Asana-leaning project-tracking, team-collaboration-work, resource-planning vs VektorOS-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Asana — Advanced features and deeper automation often require Advanced+; VektorOS — SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency.

Limitations — Asana: Advanced features and deeper automation often require Advanced+; AI Studio credit packaging can raise TCO beyond Starter seat floors; VektorOS: SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency.

Poor-fit cases: Asana is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Advanced features and deeper automation often require Advanced+ · VektorOS is a poor fit when that limitation bites: SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency · Avoid Asana if you actually need VektorOS's motion (Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
